Marcus only said roadmap and unconfirmed timing.","utterance_ids":["U016","U018"]},{"check":"quote_supports_claim","artifact":"recap_email","target":"the readmission pipeline ran on your de-identified extract in nine minutes, with the top three drivers on each row and score restatement when late claims arrive.","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"The nine minutes, top three drivers and restatement are all stated by Marcus in the call and cited correctly.","utterance_ids":["U028","U034","U041"]},{"check":"email_promises_uncommitted","artifact":"recap_email","target":"We will send the security packet to Aisha, copying Raj, ahead of the October 9th committee.","passed":false,"severity":"medium","finding":"Aisha asked that the packet go to her with Raj copied and Jordan said 'Got it', but no one owns or dates the packet, and the SSO design piece depends on an unresolved answer;
